lines.text: The commander wants to learn why the Jews accuse Paul, so he brings him before the Sanhedrin.
The high priest Ananias orders Paul struck on the mouth, and Paul calls him a whitewashed wall.
Paul says he is a Pharisee on trial for his hope in the resurrection, and the Pharisees and Sadducees divide over it.

wrong_details.wrong: Paul says he is a Pharisee on trial for his hope in the resurrection, and the Pharisees and Sadducees divide over it. (The Sadducees acknowledge angels and spirits)
wrong_details.true: The Pharisees acknowledge the resurrection, angels and spirits, while the Sadducees say there is none

lines.text: Some Pharisee scribes say they find nothing wrong with Paul, and the commander fears Paul will be torn apart and sends him to the temple.
The following night the Lord stands near Paul and tells him to take courage because he must testify in Rome.
